mapJoinImplications: Connecticut 2024 result availability is town-centric. County joins are context only because the active county geometry summarizes eight historical county areas rather than the town reporting units used by EMS.
Town/MCD geometry from Census TIGERweb is the preferred next map join target for native CT result/review/turnout rows.
Ward/precinct maps should not be implied from the current data. EMS exposes 759 polling-place labels and reporting status, but candidate vote rows below town grain were not confirmed in static JSON.
